title: New NVIDIA UEFI GPU Unlocker Brings Up To 75% Higher AI Compute Performance To RTX 20, 30 & 40 Series GPUs On Windows
description: A new open-source tool called NV UEFI Unlocker promises to unleash previously restricted Tensor Core compute performance on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 20, 30, and 40 Series GPUs, bringing functionality previously associated primarily with Linux-based modifications to Windows users. Developed by GitHub user physicsdolphin, the NV UEFI Unlocker project uses a UEFI-based approach to modify GPU behavior before NVIDIA's graphics driver initializes. Unlike traditional firmware modifications, it doesn't require permanently flashing the GPU's VBIOS or patching NVIDIA's drivers. The unlock is temporary and disappears after a complete power-off.
